transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… people have been saying I’m hard to follow lately. Like with my artist statements or client notes, even in meetings, I’ll start on textures and somehow end up talking about budgets or meanings behind things, and they tell me it doesn’t really connect. So… that’s why I came in.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?

Yeah… sometimes. I’ll get these stretches where I feel really lit up, like every idea I have is brilliant and I can just keep going. But then if someone says one small thing, I can snap at them harder than I mean to.
When you’re in those lit-up stretches, do you need much less sleep than usual?
Yeah. I mean… I can work really late, sleep maybe two or three hours, and then wake up feeling pretty bright. Like I’m ready to keep going, not really tired like I usually would be.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?

Sometimes, yeah. Mostly when I’m alone in the studio. I’ll hear… like a woman’s voice, quiet, commenting from somewhere behind the shelves. Or I’ll smell hot metal near a piece I haven’t finished. It feels real at the time, but when I check, there’s nothing there.
Do the voice and the smell ever happen when you are not in one of those lit-up, high-energy stretches?

Yeah… it has happened outside of that. There was maybe a quieter month where I was sleeping more normally, not feeling all unstoppable, and I still heard those comments from behind the shelves. And I’d… read warnings into normal studio stuff for a few weeks. I didn’t really tell anyone.
Have there been times when you heard the voice or felt those warnings were meaningful while your mood felt completely normal?

Yeah… there was a stretch like that. My mood felt pretty normal, I was sleeping okay, not feeling all driven or unstoppable. But I still heard the comments in the studio, and I kept… taking ordinary materials as warnings for a few weeks.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I’ve had low days, but I’m not sure it was like that for two weeks straight.
When your mood feels normal, do you still believe those warnings in ordinary studio materials are truly meant for you?

Yeah. I mean… even when I feel pretty normal, I can still get stuck on it. Like a stain or a seam, or some phrase in a gallery email, it feels like it’s directed at me. Like it’s telling me something about my work. Even if someone says it’s just… nothing, it’s hard for me to drop it.
Have the voice and those warning-like messages ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not feeling high, irritable, or depressed?

Yeah… I think so. There was, like, a quieter month where I wasn’t really high or depressed. I was sleeping more normally, not feeling unstoppable or anything. But the voice—comments from behind the shelves—and the warning stuff in the studio materials still kept going for a few weeks.
During those high-energy periods, did they ever last at least one week?
Yes… they could last at least a week. Those stretches have been happening on and off for, I don’t know, around ten months.
When you hear the voice, does it ever tell you that you have special powers or a special mission?

Not really… not like special powers or a mission. It’s more that, when I’m alone in the studio, I hear a woman quietly commenting from behind the shelves. It feels real in the moment, but when I check, there’s nothing there.
Over these past ten months, have those high-energy, lit-up periods made up most of the time you’ve been unwell?

Yeah… I think so. Looking back, those energized or irritable, overproductive stretches were more of the time than the calmer parts. It kind of went up and down, but… overall, yes, more of the year was like that.
